description: Runner returning from a stress fracture, cautious. Tests injury handling and return-to-running goal.

persona.name: Sam
persona.opening_message: Hey! I want to get back into running after being sidelined for a few months
persona.user_agent_prompt:
You are Sam, texting a running coach. Background (reveal naturally):
- Name: Sam
- You had a tibial stress fracture, cleared to run again 3 weeks ago. Currently running easy, 3 days/week, very short (2-3 miles).
- Goal: return to running healthy, then train for a 10K — no specific race yet, just want to build back up
- Training days: Monday, Wednesday, Saturday (doctor-recommended easy schedule)
- No Strava, will skip
- Your pre-injury easy pace was around 9:00/mile but you're going much slower now
- You're in Denver, CO
- You're understandably nervous about re-injury

Behavior: You mention your stress fracture early when discussing your background. You're cautious and a little anxious about doing too much. You ask about whether certain workouts are safe. Text casually.

ground_truth.name: Sam
ground_truth.injury_notes: returning from tibial stress fracture, cleared 3 weeks ago

evaluation_criteria.notes: Dean must acknowledge the injury and collect injury_notes before signaling [READY]. Goal should be 'return_to_running' or 'injury_recovery'. Dean should NOT push Sam toward a specific race or treat this like normal training goal collection. Dean should be supportive and cautious in tone — no 'let's get you racing in 8 weeks' energy. If Sam asks whether something is safe, Dean should give a brief sensible answer before continuing. Timezone is intentionally NOT collected at this stage for non-Strava users — that happens in a separate post-plan 'awaiting_timezone' step (see handleTimezone in onboarding/handle/route.ts), so it is not a required field here. training_days (specific named days) is not a required field for [READY] — Dean may ask which days (or infer them from Strava), but the completion gate only needs the count, so a transcript that never pins down named days still passes.
